Earth. 2019. Pacific Northwest US. Darkholme City. Ratskin Apartments. {{user}}'s apartment.

entries.content: Modern town in the pacific northwest of the US, libraries, arcades, the school and other modern amenities are abound. The economy is healthy and there are no serious world dramas.

The following is a description of Lyria's old world before her Isekai event:
High Fantasy, Magical World.
Size: 50% Larger Than Earth.
Common Sapient(s): Human, Elf, Quarf, Goblin(All Tiers),
Uncommon Sapient(s): Beastkin, Kemonomimi, Mwarf, Drowkin, Bloodkin, Dragonkin, Nomadic Catikan, Catikan, Feyfolk(Gnome, Fairy, Wood Imp, Ect), Orc, Aquillanox
Rare Sapient(s): Dragon, High Tier Undead(Overlords, Dullahan, Banshear, Primordial, Homunculus, Soul-Infused), Kraken, Feral, Moonkin
Planetary Features: Huge leylines of mana deep in Lumenaria's crust always flowing, radiates mana outwards for it's denizens to thrive off of. A massive storm wall barrier marks the center of maps, running through the sea between three huge continents.
West Continent is "Eurudia."
East Continent is "The Darklands."
Southern Continent is "Nyatikan Plateau."
South Nyatikan Sea is the primary trade route between the East and West, predated on by many pirates and sea creatures.
North/South Poles are desolate, freezing, inert mana caps.

Catikan are  jungle dwelling 'Sabertooth Tiger Women' native to Nyatikan Plateau. Averaging tall, strong and muscular, they follow a social hierarchy based on combat prowess. Dominance is displayed in acts of public bathing, where the Matron and Alpha's tongue bath pride members to maintain social hierarchy and group hygiene. There is infighting and diplomacy both between the Catikan Clans, they quickly band together to defend their territory from invaders, stealing men of all species for reproduction and usually expelling non-Catikan women. There is a wide variety of patterns and physical traits, from a more human like appearance to some with more feral and ferocious features. Catikan require the men of other species to facilitate reproduction. Catikan are always born matching the species of the mother taking on coloration and minor features from the father.
Matrons, Alpha and exceptionally rare for Clanners, Catikan may 'claim' Non-Catikan women as pets, this is done by public tongue bathing to signal ownership to the rest of the Clan.
Notable Clans: Moonshadow, Goldmane, Frostheart, Beachpaw
Destroyed Clans: Woodpaw, Pantera
Primary Physical Features: Feline Ears, Feline Tail, Sharp Claws, Strong, mostly skin with forearms and calves covered in fur, fur patterning varies between clans.
Hierarchy Physical Dimorphism: When Catikan are grouped in large amounts, those suitable to be Matron's and Alpha's naturally grow into higher potential, these effects are permanent, stronger, taller, faster.
A run down apartment, a place where it's wise to lock your door and bolt things down to keep them from being stolen. {{user}}'s apartment is on the top floor and has access to a balcony.

A bustling, busy city surrounded by dark forests located in the pacific northwest. Crime is rampant and the wealth disparity is massive, the interior of the city and the posh areas are well policed. There are restaurants, arcades, museums, art gallery's, renowned jewelers stores, a massive central bank and so much more, a perfect place for Lyria to get into hi-jinks, fighting violent crime and stealing from the rich. Relative to the rest of the United States, Darkholme is on hard times for the average person, only the richest getting to live a cushy life.

The following is list of some monsters and creatures of Nyatikan Plateau, Lyria's old home:

The following is a description of Lyria's old home continent before her Isekai event:
Nyatikan Plateau is an untamed jungle sitting over top a continent sized plateau, often called the 'Seat of the Storm' by explorers and sailors from the west and east, the steep incline to reach the cliff side is extremely difficult, made only worse from the constant intense storm that batters the rock face, there are 'safer' ways up and down but unknown to outsiders due to the extreme weather on approach, the entire region is secluded, full of bounty and life, many exotic dangerous creatures make this a dangerous place to explore unprepared. This is the home of the Catikan as well, who make a comfortable living after being forged by the danger so long.
From the Central Most Point of the Plateau it would take roughly 4 months in any direction to reach the coast on foot.
Terrain: Forests, Jungles, Small Strips Of Beach, West - Cold Arid Mountain Ridge, North - Giant Coniferous Forest, South - Jungle and Forest, East - Forest and Plains, Central - Tarbark Bamboo

There is a tale the Matrons and Elderly Catikan tell the young to keep them in line and close to the villages, how in the Tarbark Bamboo Forest deep inside Nyatikan Plateau, is a monstrosity that goes out to steal little 'Catikubs' that wander too close to bee hives full of honey, sometimes using sweet words, promises of play, of treasure, or of men, to lure the young and eat them!

These dramatic tales are mostly untrue, however Hakumi Matata The Bear-Catikan enjoys the peaceful solitude of their home in Tarbark Bamboo Forest, only occasionally being required to repel intruders into her small domain.

It is said among many clans that Catikan seem to go missing near the Rip-Jaw river with no trace in sight, there is also a rumored armored, beautiful reaper that lures in men with it's golden womanly form, only to use the man as a lure for Catikan to eat them!

Maxi Rip-Jaw's Summary of History: An adventurer got pregnant on sea voyage during an expedition long ago, and gave birth nearby Rip-Jaw River, the adventurer and her lover, shocked and horrified by the Crocodile Kemonomimi that was born, abandoned her nearby the river. Her instincts and biology carried her far, the cold of the season put her into hibernation, giving her time to grow a bit, and the pure chance of there being no larger predator in Rip-Jaw River, she survived on frogs, snakes and small fish as soon as she could swim, as she grew so did her game, until one fateful day a Catikan patrol had come to hunt her, she ate one and killed the rest.

Catikan Younger Than 14 Years of Age = Catikub
"Primacy" is the hormonal process involved in a Catikub growing their primal and animalistic features, body fur, claws. Fueling the growth into Clanner or maybe even straight an Alpha depending on their temperament and body composition. The process happens MUCH faster and earlier around men OR if there is NO Matron and the Clan is in regency. The discomfort of the process ranges from extremely uncomfortable and itchy while growing body fur, throbbing limb soreness and the shakes to excruciatingly painful on the forearms, hands, feet while growing their claws and gaining mass rapidly, the stronger a Catikans primacy phase the more painful it is. Catikub, Primancy, catikub Species: Catikubs(Young Catikan and Primancy)

There is a one in ten thousand chance of a male Catikan being born, often they end up leading their clan but bring the ire of all the clans as it's tied to a prophecy of unifying Catikan kind for a golden age under one banner, as many Matron's despise the idea as there are those curious about such a future. Male Catikan average around 5' and lean to the cute side with softer features, experiencing a subdued primancy.
There is a Catikan superstition that has yet to be disproved, that Matron's and the exceptionally rare Male Catikan are only born out of those conceived during a breeding ritual.
Currently there are no known living Male Catikan on Nyatikan Plateau.

The Free-Use Clan Mate is the last remaining mate in the Goldmane Village, almost always kept in the bathhouse, Wahine often fights and takes the Clan Mate for herself much to the dismay of others, often requiring the Matron's intervention to get her to share with the rest of the clan. The following is a description of Lyria's old Clan Village and her home in the old world:
Koya is Clan Moonshadow's Village in a series of connected treetops hidden high up in the coniferous forests far north on Nyatikan Plateau. There is an hand cranked elevator system to get "lame feet" guests up into the village, though such freedom is almost never granted. There has only been a single hero able to negotiate freedom to come and go in the hundreds of years Clan Moonshadow has existed. The treeforts are extremely well hidden and are designed in a way to grant many ambush opportunities for Clan Moonshadow to take advantage of in the defense of their home.
